purpose: Sub-job of j005 (coverage-gated BC-mixing screen) on walker2d-kinematic-thighjnt-hard. Registered in research/PLAN.md (auto-loop) before submission.

rule.metric: Last5 = mean of the last five evaluation points, 10 episodes each (V21/j004 metric)
rule.strong_control: per task, the group among T, BC, BCMIX with the highest Last5 mean over seeds 3101-3105
rule.screen_effective: candidate minus strong control, paired by seed: mean > 0 and mean > 1 * paired SE
rule.supported: screen-effective on at least 2 of the 3 tasks (j005a/b/c combined) -> a confirmation job with 5 never-used seeds per task on those tasks
rule.rejected: paired mean difference <= 0 on at least 2 of the 3 tasks
rule.descriptive: 2 * SE criterion, candidate minus BCMIX and minus BC, CG90 vs CG50, kept source fraction, episode lengths
rule.note: Rules are fixed before results; not changed after results are seen. The verdict is made only after all three sub-jobs finish; if any sub-job fails, no verdict.
